items.title: Databricks co-founder shares his secrets for winning big enterprises customers
items.summary: Turns out selling to big companies isn’t about having the shiniest tech: it’s about hitching a ride on a giant’s sales team.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos
items.summary: As Instagram rolls out long form videos of up to 90 minutes, the platform has an opportunity to challenge YouTube if it plays its cards right.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling
